page.notes: Right-hand edge: coloured underlining and small marks beside several page numbers, not text. Doubtful: the page number after Cornua exercitus, the spelling of Sanctur, and the first word of the Cortina entry. Some words are printed in blue-underlined or marked form on the scan; these are copied as printed. "Brietas" and "Eripi" are at the edge or unclear and are marked [?].
